start.text: A crate lined with old sailcloth: Pell's lost things, sorted with great seriousness. Buttons by colour. A doll's arm. A key that has forgotten its lock. One brass hinge, and a whole door-handle.
In the middle, in a nest of unpicked wool, sits the humming pebble. It hums, low, the song nobody can finish.
In the middle is a nest of unpicked wool, pressed into the shape of the pebble in your pocket.

empty_nest.text: In the middle is a nest of unpicked wool with nothing in it. Everything else in the crate has been pushed back from it, carefully, to leave it room.
A scrap of sailcloth is tucked into the side. In Pell's big letters: DONT MOVE THE NEST. It doesn't say why.

green_glass.text: On top sits a new treasure: a chip of green bottle-glass, polished smooth. FERRY is scratched into the cloth beside it.
